most_relevant.description:
Perfect breakfast place if you want to get something different from regular Indian breakfast options. They serve a great range of breakfast with some really delectable egg recipes. Place also offers Goan Ross Omlette wit Poi.
Coffee is again superb and amazing, in fact the tea was also very flavourful, breads they serve are baked to perfection.

Staff is very courteous and atmosphere in the cafe is great and soothing. This is sort ofy goto place in my every visit to Goa.

Visited this restaurant with family for a Sunday morning brunch.
This restaurant is neat, clean and well kept.

It has a very cozy vibe.
There is a small indoor dining area and a large alfresco dining area.

The interiors are good and so is the service. Gerald and his colleague were welcoming and were very hospitable.

Food is excellent, particularly if you like English or American breakfast.

It is one of the only places that offers all day breakfast in the Candolim area.

The food was delicious, large portions, and it was of good value! The service was very good. We had a chat with the manager Bijendra, who gave us a lot of good advice, and he was a great conversationalist! Would definitely return.

The Food was amazing! The English Breakfast plate was so worth the price and so tasty. Also, their white egg omelette was so tasty, never had something like that before!
Also their staff is also very nice and amazing! Really liked the whole experience and loved spending time there. Really a must go!

I am not sure how the rating is high for this place. The food is below average and very disappointing.

Watermelon feta salad has feta for namesake. Pizza had no flavours and salt was missing. Aglio olio has no garlic flavor.

Coffee was great though.

Also when asked about the specialty and must try items they arrogantly said everything is specialty. I guess everything was specially disappointing.

Pleas skip for food, try coffee!

An excellent break up place in Candolim.

We ordered Chicken pesto sandwich, Goan egg curry and poi and Egg florentine.
Chicken pesto sandwich - This was very well cooked. The break was fresh and meat was soft & just juicy enough.
Goan egg curry - This was the first time we were trying this and we don't regret it. This is usually served with the local bread - Poi
Egg Florentine - This was similar to other continental places we had tried. But nevertheless it was good.
Cold coffee - they recommended that this was their signature drink. This was decent.
We wanted to try the almond croissants as well but the staff themselves recommended that we will be too full for that 😄

Eventually we couldn't finish it and bad to pack the sandwich. The portion size is pretty good here.
Highly recommended if you are looking for a quick, chill breakfast cafe

Ordered their honey mustard and pesto cottage sandwiches with iced latte and americano. For coffee the beans used were amazing, I found the americano serving to be a bit lesser, but iced katte was good. The sizes of the sandwich were large and were fresh. The wedges on the side were amazing.

Lots of other people around us ordered english breakfast, and those looked amazing as well. The portion size was large and the staff was kind.

Visited this place for breakfast and trust me you won’t be disappointed. We tried few sandwiches and English breakfast and everything was delicious.
Definitely will revisit if time permits to try other dishes
